_note: Hover help for this project's buttons, menu items and tabs (project-owned). Key = the control's text, optionally preceded by where it is: tab / sub-tab / group box titles (outermost first) or a dialog's title, joined with ' > '. The most specific match wins; '&', a trailing '...' and case are ignored. An empty text = no tooltip on purpose. Engine controls (developer buttons, Environment tab, OK / Cancel / Close ...) already have entries in Base\Services_ToolTips.psm1; an entry here overrides them. The developer build lists every control still missing one in <data root>\Logs\ToolTips_missing.txt.

ToolTips.Overview: What this tool does and how the tabs fit together.
ToolTips.Drivers: Build RSLinx Ethernet drivers from the device registry and put them on this PC; back up and restore them.
ToolTips.Site Codes: Lease -> site code table used to name drivers. Saved per environment.
ToolTips.VLAN Lookup: Subnet -> VLAN / driver name table used to group IPs into drivers. Saved per environment.
ToolTips.RSLinx: The RSLinx Classic control panel, shown inside this tab.
ToolTips.Drivers > Restart as administrator: Start this app again as administrator (needed to change drivers), then close this copy.
ToolTips.Drivers > Load CSV file: Read a device registry CSV export and build the preview from it.
ToolTips.Drivers > Paste clipboard: Paste device registry rows (or a Name,Node driver list) from the clipboard.
ToolTips.Drivers > Build preview: Turn the pasted rows into drivers (named from the VLAN lookup and site codes) in the preview.
ToolTips.Drivers > Include inactive devices: Also use devices marked inactive in the device registry.
ToolTips.Drivers > Include Secondary IPs: Also use each device's secondary IP addresses, not only the primary one.
ToolTips.Drivers > All: Tick every site in the site list.
ToolTips.Drivers > None: Untick every site in the site list.
ToolTips.Drivers > Add to this PC: Add the ticked preview rows to this PC's drivers; existing drivers are kept. A backup is taken first.
ToolTips.Drivers > Overwrite this PC: Replace ALL of this PC's Ethernet drivers with the ticked preview rows. A backup is taken first.
ToolTips.Drivers > Use selected: Tick the selected preview rows so they are applied.
ToolTips.Drivers > Skip selected: Untick the selected preview rows so they are left out.
ToolTips.Drivers > Remove selected rows: Take the selected rows out of the preview (nothing on this PC changes).
ToolTips.Drivers > Clear preview: Empty the preview (nothing on this PC changes).
ToolTips.Drivers > Refresh: Read this PC's drivers and the backup list again.
ToolTips.Drivers > Remove selected IPs: Remove the selected IPs from this PC's drivers; a driver left empty is deleted. A backup is taken first.
ToolTips.Drivers > Copy to preview: Copy the selected (or all) drivers on this PC into the preview, e.g. to edit and write them back.
ToolTips.Drivers > Save current: Save this PC's drivers to a CSV backup now (you can add a name).
ToolTips.Drivers > Restore to preview: Load the selected backup into the preview; then Add or Overwrite puts it on this PC.
ToolTips.Drivers > Open folder: Open the backup folder in Explorer.
ToolTips.Site Codes > Add row: Add an empty row to the table.
ToolTips.Site Codes > Delete selected: Delete the selected rows (saved only when you click Save).
ToolTips.Site Codes > Save: Save the table for this environment (the old one is kept as .bak).
ToolTips.Site Codes > Reload: Throw away unsaved edits and load the saved table again.
ToolTips.Site Codes > Reset to shipped defaults: Replace the table with the one that ships with the app (saved only when you click Save).
ToolTips.VLAN Lookup > Add row: Add an empty row to the table.
ToolTips.VLAN Lookup > Delete selected: Delete the selected rows (saved only when you click Save).
ToolTips.VLAN Lookup > Save: Save the table for this environment (the old one is kept as .bak).
ToolTips.VLAN Lookup > Reload: Throw away unsaved edits and load the saved table again.
ToolTips.VLAN Lookup > Import CSV: Replace or extend the table from a CSV file (Site, IpBase, Cidr, Vlan, Description).
ToolTips.VLAN Lookup > Export CSV: Save the table to a CSV file.
ToolTips.VLAN Lookup > Reset to shipped defaults: Replace the table with the one that ships with the app (saved only when you click Save).
ToolTips.RSLinx > Refresh: Read the RSLinx version, service and driver details again.
ToolTips.RSLinx > Start / re-attach control panel: Start the RSLinx Classic control panel (or find it again) and show it inside this tab.
ToolTips.RSLinx > Open in its own window: Let go of the control panel so it runs in its own window.
